title: Finite local constancy of a restricted tensor with bounded-above inputs
statement: Let $a:X\to T$ be a scheme morphism and $A$ a finite commutative ring. Work in the actual categories of module sheaves over the constant ring $A$ on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $Q$ denote localization to the derived category [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Let $K^\bullet,L^\bullet,P^\bullet$ be cochain complexes on $T$, let $f:P^\bullet\to K^\bullet$ be a quasi-isomorphism, and suppose $P^\bullet$ is acyclic-tensor K-flat, as used in [def-weil-derived-tensor]. Suppose the termwise pullbacks $a_A^*K^\bullet$ and $a_A^*L^\bullet$ have cohomology bounded above. In every degree $j$ with $H^j(QK^\bullet)\ne0$, suppose its restriction to $X$ is locally constant as an $A_X$-module [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] and has finite geometric module stalks [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk]; impose the analogous condition for $L^\bullet$. Then, for every integer $i$, the restriction to $X$ of $H^i(K^\bullet\otimes_A^L L^\bullet)$, computed by the given K-flat resolution [def-weil-derived-tensor], is locally constant and has finite geometric module stalks. No constructible stratification is assumed, and no lower bound on the output is asserted.

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-proetale-constant-module-pullback-homology] to identify the cohomology of the termwise restricted inputs with the restricted input cohomology. When H^j of an input is zero, its restriction is zero; the zero module sheaf has the constant zero local model and zero stalks. Otherwise use the given local models and finite stalks. Thus every restricted input cohomology is finite locally constant. The two restricted complexes already have the assumed upper bounds.

source.place: Section 0735 and Tag 094H, restriction and upper bounds

proof.text: Convert finite module stalks to finite local-model values. A nonempty covering member has a geometric point; the constant-module germ isomorphism of [lem-weil-proetale-constant-sheaf-stalk] identifies its value with a finite stalk of the input. On an empty member choose the zero model. Finite modules are finitely generated. Pulling the terminal trivializing cover back to an arbitrary object gives the covering-sieve formulation of locally constant finite type in [lem-weil-pbc-locally-constant-tensor]. Over the AsSmall site model all object, arrow, and coefficient universes agree; transport the coefficient sheaf and local models via its explicit site equivalence and the constant-section-preserving coefficient isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 094H; Modules on Sites, locally constant finite type models

proof.text: A finite commutative ring is Noetherian: each ideal is generated by its finite underlying set. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-locally-constant-tensor] to the restricted bounded-above objects and K-flat representatives. It gives locally constant finite type cohomology in every degree. Use the canonical derived tensor pullback comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback] for the pro-etale inverse image; its hypotheses hold because that inverse image is exact with the canonical constant coefficient comparison. The comparison computes the chosen derived tensor using arbitrary K-flat representatives; replacing the second factor by a K-flat resolution does not change it, since P is K-flat, and replacing P by another K-flat representative likewise does not change the resulting derived object.

Transport the cohomology isomorphism back from the small site model to the original ringed pro-etale site. A finitely generated module over a finite ring is a quotient of a finite power of the ring and hence finite. The local constant germ theorem [lem-weil-proetale-constant-sheaf-stalk] identifies each geometric stalk with such a finite model, giving finite stalks and local constancy of the restricted tensor cohomology. All constructions are valid on the empty scheme. The argument is degreewise and never asserts a lower bound for the tensor.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtale_restrictedTensor_finiteLocalConstancy
    {T X : Scheme.{u}} (a : X ⟶ T) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (K L P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) ℤ)
    (f : P ⟶ K) (hf : QuasiIso f)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := proEtaleConstantRing T A) P)
    (hKb : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j → IsZero
      (((proEtaleConstantModulePullbackFunctor a A).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) |>.obj K).homology j))
    (hLb : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j → IsZero
      (((proEtaleConstantModulePullbackFunctor a A).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) |>.obj L).homology j))
    (hK : ∀ j : ℤ, ¬ IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)) →
      IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf X A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (proEtaleRingModules T
          (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))) ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
        Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk x (proEtaleConstantRing X A)
          (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)))))
    (hL : ∀ j : ℤ, ¬ IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj
          (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)) →
      IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf X A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (proEtaleRingModules T
          (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L))) ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
        Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk x (proEtaleConstantRing X A)
          (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) j).obj
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj L)))))
    (i : ℤ) :
    IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf X A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (proEtaleRingModules T
        (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) i).obj (derivedTensor T A K L P f hf hP))) ∧
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk x (proEtaleConstantRing X A)
        (proEtaleConstantModulePullback a A ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T A)) i).obj
            (derivedTensor T A K L P f hf hP))))
